name: News-sentiment overreaction fade on 1h bars (faster headline snapback, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: same headline-overreaction reversal as the 4h fade, but on 1h bars to capture a FASTER snapback — the sharpest emotional overshoots reprice within the first hour or two, and a shorter hold reduces exposure to a follow-through leg while the reversion premium is fattest right after the shock. Entry: news_sentiment in an extreme LOW tail AND a 1h price drop (ret_Nd). Long the bounce, exit within a few bars. This is a timeframe-distinct bet on WHERE in the reversion curve the edge lives, and it is the harshest fee test in the family. DISCONFIRMER: 1h round-trips pay fees more often — if per-trade net edge < 2x fee+slippage the faster clock is strictly worse; kill and prefer 4h. If the 1h fade matches random-bar mean-reversion, news adds nothing — kill.
catalyst: extreme-negative news sentiment confirmed by a 1h price drop
